text:
anna: Midnight fastcut request — urgent hotfix for EU1 request routing bug. Rejection rate ~5% for inference requests after 23:40 UTC. Patch built and tested on staging. Asking for expedited approval to pin and push v2.1.3-hotfix to EU pool in a midnight window (00:15 UTC).

anna: TL;DR:
- Change: fix off-by-one in shard selector
- Action: pin v2.1.3-hotfix -> eu-pool, 10m 5% canary then 30% ramp if healthy
- Rollback criteria: error rate x3 baseline OR p95 latency > 300ms OR spike in token OOMs
- Telemetry: extra tracing and K/V cache metrics enabled

anna: Deploy command (will run after approvals):
```
./deployctl promote --service=inference-eu --from=stable --to=v2.1.3-hotfix --canary=5% --canary-duration=10m
```

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: eu-pool v2.1.3-hotfix. Canary window 00:15-00:25 UTC. See /status link: https://deploy.internal/redwood/eu-pool

sam: Quick Q — is there a DB migration or config flip? Need release notes line.

anna: No DB migration. Config flip only for shard selector logic. I'll add release note: "Fix shard selector off-by-one causing 5% request rejections in eu region."

maria: Please add a short smoke test in post-deploy checklist to hit 3 endpoints and verify 200 and correct routing.

mike_oncall: I can be on monitor for the window. I'll keep pager open and watch SLO dashboard. +1 from ops.

sam: +1 from product for expedited

maria: +1, smoke tests ready. I'll run them after canary passes.

anna: rolling canary now (initiating at 00:15 UTC)

deploy-bot: canary started at 2480045760; canary id 7865. Health checks: pass->OK, latency p95 baseline 110ms

mike_oncall: seeing minor uptick in 50x errors, 1.2x baseline. watching.

deploy-bot: canary metrics @00:20 UTC: errors within threshold, latency p95 125ms, mem stable. Canary healthy -> proceeding to 30% ramp.

sam: noted. waiting for post-ramp metrics.

maria: running smoke tests now: /predict, /health, /cache_status -> all 200 and expected routing.

maria: smoke tests clean.

deploy-bot: ramp to 30% completed at 2480045860. No rollback triggered. Promotion complete. Service pinned to v2.1.3-hotfix for eu-pool.

anna: thanks team. I'll post release note and close the thread. :shipit:
